THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STUDIO
139
STUDY 147
Lilac Mesh Top & Metal Belt
Rights check / Repeats Study 152.
Source: 25043.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black hair
falls past her shoulders and wears layered silver
necklaces. She wears a lilac long-sleeve mesh top with
a scoop neckline, a sheer lace-trimmed bodice with
small floral embroidery, and a center zip. A wide
embellished metal belt sits low over dark flare jeans.
Pointed silver-toned shoes complete the look. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light.
Palette of lilac, charcoal denim, and silver. Playful and
delicate, in the style of a Y2K lookbook.
Playful, delicate, Y2K
WORKING NOTES
- The sheer lace bodice and metal belt are the signature
details.
- Keep the flare jeans for a retro silhouette.
